153a154,174
> vdo.dev.write_amplification PMID: 129.5.182 [Ratio of backing-store writes to incoming write bios]
>     Data Type: float  InDom: 129.5 0x20400005
>     Semantics: instant  Units: none
> Help:
> Ratio of physical (data plus metadata) write bios issued by VDO to its backing
